data.name: Dhanjit
data.gender_notes: Dhanjit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dhanjit is a Sanskrit name derived from the words Dhan (wealth or treasure) and Jit (victory). The name signifies that the person who bears this name has been bestowed with God's wealth or treasure and has achieved victory over his enemies or challenges. In Hindu mythology, Dhanvantari, the God of Ayurveda and healer, is also known by this name.
data.spiritual_meaning: Blessed with divine wealth and strength
data.etymology: Dhanjit belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's wealth or treasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhanjit total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dhanjit carries a rich cultural legacy and represents the Hindu values of prosperity, wisdom, and victory. This name has been historically used to honor individuals who have made significant contributions in various fields, including politics, business, and spiritualism. It is believed that those who possess this name are blessed with the power to overcome obstacles and lead successful lives.
data.spiritual_significance: Dhanjit is a name deeply rooted in the Hindu belief that the divine bestows blessings and grants victory to the righteous. The name is a reminder that the spiritual journey is not just about self-realization but also about triumphing over the inner demons that hinder our progress. Dhanjit is a symbol of the abundant grace of the universe and the power of the divine to bless us with material and spiritual wealth. Further, it echoes the teachings of Hindu texts, such as the Bhagavad Gita, which encourage us to strive for victory (jit) in life, but also to devote ourselves to the divine source of all wealth and success (dhan).
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Dhanjit symbolizes the accumulation of wealth and prosperity through righteous means and hard work. It is a reminder to keep striving towards financial stability and material success while maintaining a virtuous and ethical character.
